name: luminaac-native
description: Capacitor shell for LuminAAC My Voice and the Bridge, with background location.

scripts.add:android: npm run copy-web && npx cap add android && node native-config.mjs android
scripts.add:ios: npm run copy-web && npx cap add ios && node native-config.mjs ios
scripts.sync: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync && node native-config.mjs
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
